verifiedStructure: The 2025 entrant catalogue identifies eight 5-EC core courses and a zero-credit Personal Development Track; its first-page structure instead states 45 core EC and 60 choice EC. Current Sustainability requirements apply to 2025 entrants: 75 EC including the 15-EC individual Capstone. Preserve only the supported 175-EC subset. The 2026 entrant 40-core/65-choice structure cannot be combined with a major explicitly assigned to the older cohort.
routeFinding: The Sustainability major integrates life sciences, social sciences, economics and humanities. It remains a defensible representative route for the generic LAS identity, selected independently of UCR fit. Its exact cohort requirements still need resolution.
verifiedConditions: Basics of Life is required for Sustainability. At least 60 prior EC precede 300-level study. The selected 20-EC major choices contain at least 10 EC at 300 level. The 2025 entrant Beyond Modernity course is distinct from the renamed 2026 Power and Resistance course. Basestone is ACC114 for the 2025 core. A later SBS325 selection needs SBS208 earlier in choice space. ECB313 cannot overlap MINUC-03.
essentialUnresolved: Establish one coherent current 180-EC EUC pathway. For the 2025 entrant cohort, clarify the stated 45-EC Academic Core versus eight listed 5-EC courses, confirm its 60-EC choice allocation and the 45-EC core requirement for Capstone entry. Alternatively, provide the applicable major requirements and corrected Capstone conditions for the 2026 entrant 40-EC core. Identify the controlling ARR and cohort; a numerical sum assembled across different cohorts is insufficient.
reasonableOfficialAlternative: Inspected the currently linked catalogue and first-year catalogue, the current curriculum and major pages, the public ARR-link page and focused official search. The ARR link explicitly requires ERNA and redirects to institutional sign-in. Search revealed a third-party November-2025 catalogue lead but no authenticated official current replacement; that third-party extract is not adopted as controlling evidence. The current public CAP400 entry still requires 45 core EC. No invented 5-EC component, mixed-cohort closure or source retry loop.
finding: First essential-source execution in this audit. No inherited approval or old failure count. External pathway remains unresolved; no final comparison or no-match.
